invalidMode: invalid daemon mode: {mode} (expected primary or follower)
seededRegistry: seeded an empty cluster registry at {path}
alreadyRunning: a daemon is already running on {socket}
noFollowerLink: instance targets daemon "{name}" but no follower link exists
primaryOnlyUpgrade: only the primary daemon can upgrade another daemon
primaryOnlyCheck: only the primary daemon can check another daemon for upgrades
consoleTimeout: daemon "{name}" did not answer the console request; its build may predate console tunnelling
consoleUnreachable: daemon "{name}" is not connected; its console is unreachable
machineUnreachable: {machine} is unreachable; its plugin port configuration was not checked

checks.noListener: no TCP listener configured; this host cannot accept followers
checks.nothingToProbe: no running instance to probe on {host}

upgrade.noPrimarySource: primary: this daemon has no primary to upgrade from
upgrade.platformMismatch: primary: its binary is {theirs}, this machine is {ours}
upgrade.noAsset: github: no release with a {asset} asset in {repo}
upgrade.jobsRunning: {count} job(s) still running; wait for them to settle, or force the upgrade
upgrade.sourceNoBinary: this daemon runs from source, so it has no binary to serve; build one with `bun run build`
upgrade.sourceNoUpgrade: this daemon runs from source; restart it from the new tree instead of upgrading
upgrade.dirNotWritable: cannot replace {path}: {dir} is not writable by this daemon; re-run "sudo luna setup" here to move it onto a binary the service account owns
upgrade.nothingNewer: already running {version}; nothing newer on any channel{why}
upgrade.noSourceWhy: no upgrade source could be reached{why}

steps.checking: checking the binary, the running jobs and the install directory
steps.asking: asking every channel what it has

rootNotFound: cluster root not found; set root in the daemon config, LUNA_ROOT, or run inside the cluster directory

log.protocolMismatch: protocol mismatch; attempting a self-upgrade from the primary
log.noToken: warning: no cluster token configured; followers cannot authenticate
log.droppingLink: follower "{name}" missed {count} heartbeats; dropping the link

sampler.noHeartbeatSince: no heartbeat since {ago}; the plugin has stopped reporting
sampler.neverReported: never reported to the proxy; check the LunaCore config

clientUnavailable: luna daemon is not running on this host; start it with `luna daemon run`, or install the service: `luna daemon service install`
protocolSkew: daemon protocol {daemon} does not match this binary ({client}); restart the daemon from the same build
